_about: Warehouse 129 (the owner, 2026-11-22): the unit is the script, not the language. Every script the platform names is declared here; only a script with 'supported': true has fonts (font_pairs.json), a direction, formats and heading limits. A declared but unsupported script RAISES wherever it is used (omni_prod/typography), and a script not declared here raises too: nothing ever falls back to Latin. Formats: 'date' is a pattern of DD, MM and YYYY; numbers are written with Western digits in every supported script (the customer's own phones and prices are written that way; Eastern Arabic digits are not built). Currency: the symbols a page of this script may show, and where the symbol stands; a currency not listed raises (no default currency). heading_max_chars: Hebrew equals the content route's schema bounds (site_content/schema.py reads them from here); Arabic and Latin are estimates from average glyph width, not measured. 'ריווח', 'כוונת חיפוש' and 'קורפוס' of 129 are not built.
